description: Declarations written in YAML that break several rules, with the one issue that reading and conversion report.

cases.description: Two scalars that cannot be coerced. The first in the order of the canonical serialisation is reported, under 'estimands', although the one under 'table' comes first in the text.

issues.message: The value 'no' at /estimands/0/focal cannot be read as a boolean.

cases.description: A title in NFD early in the text and a boolean that cannot be coerced under 'provenance', which comes first in canonical order.

issues.message: The value 'no' at /provenance/outcome_seen cannot be read as a boolean.

cases.description: A key in NFD whose value holds a bound that cannot be coerced. A key is checked before its value.

issues.message: The string at /variables/âge is not in Unicode normalisation form C (NFC).

cases.description: A nested mapping with a duplicate key that ends before a syntax error later in the text. Whichever comes first in the order of events is reported.

issues.message: A YAML mapping holds a key twice.

cases.description: A duplicate key in the top-level mapping and a syntax error before that mapping ends.

issues.message: The YAML text cannot be parsed.

cases.description: A tab used for indentation, which libyaml refuses, followed by an anchor. The pre-scan runs before the parser.

issues.message: The YAML text has an anchor or an alias at byte 56. Anchors and aliases are not accepted.

cases.description: A complex key before a duplicate key. Duplicate keys are found while parsing, before keys are checked.

issues.message: A YAML mapping holds a key twice.

cases.description: U+0000 before an anchor. The pre-scan reports the first problem in the order of the text.

issues.message: The string at byte 26 contains the character U+0000.

cases.description: A boolean that cannot be coerced in a declaration with an unknown key and an unsupported version. Conversion comes before validation.

issues.message: The value 'no' at /provenance/outcome_seen cannot be read as a boolean.
